hypothesis: Canonical bounded read-only reduction loops with one conditional update arm can split before original-loop LV legality or VPlan construction. A triangle or the existing single diamond can retain the original producer branches and compact distinct contribution SSA values at one shared participation index. An ordered consumer independently selects its VF and executes exactly the compact count. Integer add and ordinary float/double add, shared contributions, explicitly safe scalar helpers and nested invocations use the same small transformation. No profitability model, pressure/depth/reduction-count threshold, or producer/consumer vectorizability prerequisite is added.
semantics: Require a single canonical zero-start/unit-step induction and unique latch controlling the original bounded eq/ne exit, a finite representable full-trip capacity, simplify form, dedicated exits and LCSSA. The fixed CFG proof admits one straight-line arm per header successor, with a direct header-to-latch edge for triangles; every original iteration visits the latch once. For a conditional recurrence the latch PHI must merge exactly its own arm-local add and unchanged header accumulator. The old accumulator has exactly these two uses, the add feeds only that merge, and the merge feeds only its own recurrence and final LCSSA exports. All reductions must share the very same update arm, with no unconditional/conditional mixture. Linear use checks therefore reject predicate/contribution/other-reduction feedback and partial-state exports without a recursive graph analysis. All producer operations, including bypass computations, remain in their original blocks and order, except the moved reduction adds and removed recurrence merges. Existing read-only memory and explicit direct memory(none), nounwind, willreturn, speculatable call contracts remain; strictfp functions, constrained FP, unsafe calls, writes, volatile/atomic accesses and unsupported live-outs remain rejected. Before original iteration i, 0<=count<=i; only the participating arm stores at count and increments once. Therefore each store index is <N<=M, final P<=N fits the IV type by the existing trip analysis, and the checked full-trip byte/index ceiling bounds every compact GEP. A latch merge retains count on bypass and exports P through an LCSSA PHI into a zero-count guard. P=0 directly exports every original initial value, with no addition or scratch load. For P>0 the consumer reads exactly initialized [0,P), in original participant order, cloning original add operand order, flags and debug locations. Its own dedicated exit has explicit LCSSA updates before joining the zero-count initial values, preserving simplify form for ordinary LV. Original exports now refer to this join. Parent loop membership, topmost-loop SE invalidation, block-disposition invalidation, dominator recalculation and caller loop-access-cache clearing are maintained. Both fission FP-option settings retain ordered behavior on this path. Executable verification requests compile references from original scalar fixtures and execute actual transformed producers, vector consumers and scalar tails. Host-only probes after PHIs count N producer iterations, P participating arm visits, floor(P/VF) vector-header visits and P%VF scalar iterations, with per-row sums and independently simulated integer alias feedback for nesting. Integer and non-NaN FP bits, signed-zero starts, exports and canaries must agree; ordinary FP NaNs use classification because LLVM does not promise payloads.
costs: Let M be the proven maximum original trip count, P the participating count, and S the sum of allocation sizes of distinct contribution SSA values. Scratch capacity remains M*S plus existing ABI alignment padding, checked with unsigned overflow/index bounds and the existing 65536-byte default per-candidate ceiling. It does not shrink with P, is allocated statically in function entry, and can occupy frame space even on guarded bypass. Logical scratch traffic is P*S stores plus P*S loads, with no per-iteration mask/index arrays. The two mixed fixtures have four accumulators but one 65*i32, one 65*double and one 65*float array: 1044 accounted bytes including 4 padding bytes, and 32*P traffic bytes. The two i64 sums share one slot: 520 bytes and 16*P traffic. Nested i32/double uses 784 accounted bytes including 4 padding bytes, reused each row, and 24*sum(P_row) logical traffic; capacity does not multiply by Rows. Default-limit tests admit 16384 i32 slots (65536 bytes) and reject 16385 (65540); i8 capacity 255 is representable while 256 original trips are rejected. Real frame padding/cache traffic are not measured. Original input loads/helper calls execute once on their original branches, with zero new original-input rereads, contribution recomputation or duplicated producer operations. Counter overhead is one carried index PHI and latch merge per original iteration plus one nuw increment per participant, using existing producer control with no new per-iteration branch. Added consumer control runs P iterations, plus one zero-count guard per producer completion, a consumer preheader, dedicated loop exit and initial/result join. Normal LV may add its own independent vector/tail guards. There are no new alias/SCEV guards, full-trip masks, dynamic/unbounded allocations, general compaction machinery or profitability model. Analysis is linear in instructions/uses plus fixed CFG checks and existing SCEV analysis; emission uses distinct-contribution/export maps and the existing full-function dominator recalculation. Host-only probes perturb the test executable and are excluded from RVV codegen inputs.
limitations: No compiler, build, test runner, executable checker or try.sh was invoked by this worker. Source/diff review and whitespace inspection do not establish passing tests, original-corpus coverage or performance. All new results require independent harness validation. Support remains a single triangle/diamond with all conditional adds on one common arm, unchanged bypasses, canonical bounded original control and final-reduction exports. Different participation streams, unconditional/conditional mixtures, non-add recurrences, partial-state exports, nested producer CFGs, longer/chained arms, early exits, effects, unsafe/read-only-memory/indirect calls, strictfp and constrained FP are unsupported. The original unconditional header/latch path remains and the same topology proof also permits its triangular subset. The new narrow-IV and default-byte-ceiling fixtures are IR/analysis checks, not new host execution cases; host compact execution uses guarded M=65 fixtures. Host fixed-vscale execution of the explicit dont-fold-tail variant is not RVV target execution. Default EVL/VP receives IR and RVV machine-code verification only; the host specializer still rejects those intrinsics. No RVV hardware/emulator execution, measured speedup, automatically chosen corpus coverage, extra fast-math/errno assumption or mature-direction claim is made. Scratch remains full-trip and bounded per candidate rather than tiled or capped across the whole function.
